en_title: Breaking Bad Star RJ Mitte Dead at 34
subtitle: 年仅34岁
opus_summary: 《绝命毒师》演员RJ Mitte去世，年仅34岁，其代表已确认消息。据TMZ报道，得克萨斯州一名县政府官员确认其死讯，该网站获悉他死于自杀，调查仍在进行。

paragraphs.en: RJ Mitte, the actor best known for playing Walter White Jr. in Breaking Bad, has died at 34.
paragraphs.cn: 因在《绝命毒师》中饰演小沃尔特·怀特而广为人知的演员RJ Mitte去世，年仅34岁。

paragraphs.en: TMZ reported that a county official in Texas confirmed the news that he died today, October 12, 2026. The site stated it was told that Mitte died by suicide.
paragraphs.cn: 据TMZ报道，得克萨斯州一名县政府官员确认，Mitte于今天，也就是2026年10月12日去世。该网站称，据其获悉，Mitte死于自杀。

paragraphs.en: Additional details surrounding his death are unclear. An investigation is ongoing.
paragraphs.cn: 有关他去世的更多细节尚不清楚，调查仍在进行。

paragraphs.en: Mitte started his career in Hollywood with a small role in Disney's Hannah Montana before appearing as the son of Bryan Cranston's Walter White when Breaking Bad premiered in 2008. He played Walter 'Flynn' White Jr. for 56 episodes, cementing him not only as one of the AMC show's most prominent characters, but one of the more recognizable characters in TV history.
paragraphs.cn: Mitte的好莱坞演艺生涯始于迪士尼剧集《汉娜·蒙塔娜》中的一个小角色。2008年《绝命毒师》首播时，他在剧中饰演沃尔特·怀特的儿子，沃尔特则由布莱恩·克兰斯顿饰演。他在56集中饰演小沃尔特·怀特，这个角色又名「弗林」，不仅成为这部AMC剧集中最突出的角色之一，也成为电视史上辨识度较高的角色之一。

paragraphs.en: Mitte appeared in all five seasons of Breaking Bad but went on to have an acting career that saw him contribute to different mediums across the entertainment spectrum. In 2013, he showed up in a music video for Steel Panther's "Party Like Tomorrow Is The End of the World." In 2014, he appeared in nine episodes of the television series Switched at Birth.
paragraphs.cn: Mitte出演了《绝命毒师》全部五季，此后也继续演艺事业，参与了娱乐领域不同媒介的作品。2013年，他出演了Steel Panther乐队歌曲《Party Like Tomorrow Is The End of the World》的音乐视频。2014年，他参演了电视剧《错位青春》的九集。

paragraphs.en: While his time on TV screens saw him also play roles in things like Now Apocalypse and This Close, his movie resume included parts in things like 2021's Triumph, 2020's The Oak Room, and 2019's All the Little Things We Kill. His most recent project saw him star as Joshua in this year's Talking to Stranger.
paragraphs.cn: 在电视方面，他还出演了《Now Apocalypse》和《This Close》等剧集；在电影方面，他参演的作品包括2021年的《Triumph》、2020年的《The Oak Room》和2019年的《All the Little Things We Kill》。他最近的一部作品是今年的《Talking to Stranger》，他在片中饰演Joshua。

paragraphs.en: Representatives for Mitte shared a statement with TMZ confirming the passing. They called him a "beloved actor, philanthropist, and passionate disability rights advocate."
paragraphs.cn: Mitte的代表向TMZ发布声明，确认了他去世的消息。他们称他是「一位深受喜爱的演员、慈善家，也是热心倡导残障人士权益的人」。

paragraphs.en: "RJ Mitte was best known for his role as Walter 'Flynn' White Jr. on AMC’s critically acclaimed, award-winning series Breaking Bad," the message continued. "Drawing from his own experience living with cerebral palsy, Mitte brought authenticity to the role and built a platform on disability awareness and inclusion. Beyond entertaining friends and family around the world, he served as an ambassador for United Cerebral Palsy and Shriners Children’s."
paragraphs.cn: 声明接着写道：「RJ Mitte因在AMC备受好评、屡获奖项的剧集《绝命毒师》中饰演小沃尔特·怀特而广为人知，这个角色又名「弗林」。Mitte结合自己患有脑瘫的生活经历，让这个角色显得真实可信，并建立了一个提升公众对残障的认识、促进包容的平台。他不仅为世界各地的朋友和家人带来欢乐，还担任了United Cerebral Palsy和Shriners Children’s的形象大使。」
